name: crm.investor.pipeline
description: Manage the investor outreach pipeline. Research VCs, angels, and accelerators in digital health. Prepare pitch decks, track interactions, and optimize the fundraising funnel.
author: DoctaRx Genesis

steps.name: Research active digital health investors
steps.prompt: Research and compile a list of 20 investors (VCs, angels, accelerators) actively investing in digital health / telehealth in 2025-2026. For each: firm name, partner name, portfolio examples, investment range, thesis alignment with DoctaRx, and best contact approach. Prioritize those who have recently invested in similar companies.

steps.name: Create personalized investor outreach plan
steps.prompt: For the top 10 scored investors, create a personalized outreach sequence: 1) Warm intro attempt (mutual connections, events) 2) Cold email with tailored angle 3) Social media engagement strategy 4) Follow-up cadence. Each sequence should reference their specific portfolio and thesis.
